people.name: Ashtaroth
people.line: A city of Og, king of Bashan.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Golan
people.line: A city of refuge in Bashan, allotted to Manasseh.

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
translations.bsb: This is what the Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: From the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan, a city of refuge for the manslayer, and Beeshterah—two cities, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.
translations.asv: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with its suburbs, the city of refuge for the manslayer, and Be-eshterah with its suburbs; two cities.
